Safety Features

Stake.us is a secure site, which uses encryption and firewalls to protect players. You can also set up two-factor authentication to add an extra degree of security to your account.

In 2017, entrepreneurs Edward Craven and Bijan Tehrani launched Stake.com via a holding company called Medium Rare N.V. The site proved extremely popular, and it is now one of the world’s largest online casinos.

However, Stake.com was never able to expand into the United States, as crypto gambling sites are prohibited there. In 2022, the company decided to launch Stake.us, a social casino that offers promotional sweepstakes play. A Cyprus-based subsidiary called Sweepsteaks Limited runs the site.

Social casinos are not licensed and regulated in the US. Instead, they must comply with federal laws, such as the Fair Credit Billing Act. They also adhere to the local sweepstakes rules in each state. To do so, Stake.us cannot sell its SC. You can only receive SC for free through bonuses, giveaways, handwritten requests, or as a gift when you buy Gold Coins.
